markscheme.source_marking_leaf_evidence:
Award max [6].
Award [1] for correct initialization (before the loop)
Award [1] for correct loop through the NUMBERS stack using isEmpty()
Award [1] for taking an element from the top of the NUMBERS stack using pop()(within the loop)
Award [1] for changing the value of SMALLEST if needed
Award [1] for changing the value of LARGEST if needed
Award [1] for placing SMALLEST and LARGEST on the stack NUMBERS using push() (after the
loop)
Award [1] for the order of push operations: first push LARGEST onto the stack then SMALLEST
(so that SMALLEST will be on the top of stack NUMBERS)
Example 1: 
X = NUMBERS.pop()
SMALLEST = X
LARGEST = X   
//  OR 
//   initialization 
//   SMALEST= 999999999999 (any very large number) 
//   LARGEST= -999999999999 (negative number!) 
loop while not NUMBERS.isEmpty() 
//searching for the smallest and largest value 
X=NUMBERS.pop() 
if X <= SMALLEST 
then SMALLEST = X 
else if X >= LARGEST 
then LARGEST = X 
end if 
end if  
end loop 
NUMBERS.push(LARGEST) 
NUMBERS.push(SMALLEST) 
Example 2: 
SMALLEST = NUMBERS.peek()   //initialization
LARGEST = SMALLEST
loop while NUMBERS.isEmpty()= false 
//searching for the smallest and largest value 
X=NUMBERS.pop() 
if X < SMALLEST 
then SMALLEST = X 
end if 
if X > LARGEST 
then LARGEST = X 
end if 
end loop  
NUMBERS.push( LARGEST) 
NUMBERS.push(SMALLEST)
